subject: ACME: Q3 coverage heatmap + micro-commit cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACME: Q3 coverage heatmap + micro-commit cadence

Team —

I pulled a quick coverage snapshot for ACME and we have a noticeable clustering in late-stage opportunities that need explicit micro-commits to make our Q3 forecast defensible. Attached is a one-page snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_Q3.pdf) — please review.

Ask: by end of day today can each AE own the following and reply in-thread?
- Current best committed ARR for ACME (USD) and where it sits by stage (Proposal, Contracting, Legal).
- Next 7–14 day blocker and the exact action needed to move stage (e.g., PO approval, SOC2 evidence, signature).
- If you expect the deal to close this quarter, add a crisp commit date.

I want to produce a micro-commit plan we can present to finance tomorrow (Mon 7/20) that shows our pipe-to-quota coverage and the items that require exec escalation.

I also started a draft mutual action plan in the shared Drive and attached an editable version (ACME_MutualActionPlan.xlsx) — populate the timeline column when you reply.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

[attachment: pipeline_snapshot_Q3.pdf (one-page coverage heatmap)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME: Q3 coverage heatmap + micro-commit cadence

Jordan / Laura —

Quick update on ACME (pulling numbers from my latest notes):
- Opportunity size: $1,200,000 ARR
- Current stage: Contracting (legal review + procurement PO)
- Confidence/probability (my view): 60% if we get PO by 7/30; drops to 25% if PO slips into Aug.

7–14 day blockers and next steps:
- Blocker: Procurement needs an SOC2 AICPA letter and our standard SLA addendum signed.
  - Action: I have a call with their procurement lead (procurement@acmecorp.com) on Tue 7/21 to confirm exact PO template requirements.
- Blocker: Pricing alignment on volume discounts (they asked for a floor at 15% off list for >1M ARR).
  - Action: Requesting written approval path from Finance; can Laura advise on an allowable one-off concession?

Commit cadence (what I'll update in the MAP):
- 7/21: confirm PO template and send revised SLA addendum
- 7/23: procurement issues PO draft
- 7/30: target for signed PO (optimistic)

Attached the mutual action plan with my timeline notes. I marked the pricing ask in the comments of the spreadsheet.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

[attachment: ACME_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (editable MAP with comments)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME: Q3 coverage heatmap + micro-commit cadence

Thanks Marcus — good detail. Quick notes from a coverage and finance-readiness lens: 

1) Micro-commit template we need in the MAP for finance:
   - Credible close date (day/month)
   - Trigger for revenue recognition (PO vs signed contract)
   - Any one-time concessions (amount and approval owner)

2) Coverage math (simple):
   - Quota for Q3: $3,000,000 ARR (team)
   - Required coverage target: 1.8x to be comfortable = $5.4M pipeline at weighted value
   - Current weighted pipeline (per snapshot): $4.1M (gap = $1.3M)
   - ACME weighted contribution if PO lands this quarter: $720k (60% of $1.2M)

3) Asks to AEs:
   - Marcus: set explicit commit (PO target) and record the approval path for any >10% discount.
   - Dylan: please sweep adjacent opportunities in Retail segment — call out any near-term adds that can plug gaps.

I can clear a quick finance escalation if we need to approve a one-off concession; mark any $ amounts clearly in the MAP and flag me.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acmecorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME: Q3 coverage heatmap + micro-commit cadence

Thanks Marcus — and Jordan, Laura — appreciate the MAP and the snapshot. A couple quick clarifications from our side before procurement issues a PO: 

- Pricing: we are still evaluating the 15% volume discount. Can you confirm whether that is a listed tier or a bespoke concession? If bespoke, who signs off?
- SOC2 evidence: our security team needs the latest SOC2 Type II report and a short note on data retention policies.
- Timeline: procurement is aiming to issue a PO by 7/25 if the above items are satisfied.

If you can confirm pricing path and provide the SOC2 PDF by EOD Mon 7/20 we will prioritize the PO.

Best,
Emily Stone
SVP, IT Procurement — Acme Corp
emily.stone@acmecorp.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acmecorp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME: Q3 coverage heatmap + micro-commit cadence

Emily — thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Pricing: the 15% is not a listed tier in our standard price book; it falls into a "strategic volume concession" path. Laura can approve up to 10% in Sales Ops; anything >10% requires Finance approval. If you want us to accelerate Finance review, we can submit a one-off request today.

2) SOC2: attaching the latest SOC2 Type II summary and the data retention FAQ (link below).

3) Timeline: Marcus will push to procurement on 7/21 and we will aim for PO by 7/25 — I will follow up personally after Marcus's 7/21 call.

Action items:
- Marcus: update the MAP with PO target date and include a short note on who will sign for the concession (if needed).
- Laura: if needed, please initiate a Finance approval thread for concession >10%.
- Emily: if procurement can send the PO template to procurement@redwood.com I will review it and confirm we can match terms.

DocuSign link for the SLA addendum (pre-filled): https://docusign.net/ACME-sign-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2026-Q3-01
Drive MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ACME-pipeline

I'll post a one-line status to Finance after Marcus updates the MAP.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

[attachments: SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (stub), data_retention_FAQ.pdf (stub)]
